name: Hentai Isekai: La Maldición del Sexo
source:
Summoned by accident to a fantasy world by a priestess named Lyria, something went wrong: someone interfered with the ritual and marked your body with a cursed seal. That mark consumes your Ether, the life energy that keeps every being alive in this world. And there’s only one way to restore it: through shared sexual pleasure.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159380/]Steam[/url]]

被一位名叫莉莉亚的女祭司偶然召唤到一个奇幻世界，但出了点问题：有人干扰了仪式，并在你的身上贴上了被诅咒的印记。该标记会消耗你的以太，以太是维持这个世界上每个生物生存的生命能量。只有一种方法可以恢复它：通过分享性快感。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159380/]Steam[/url]]
